classifications.evidence: Vendor stylesheet is the exact pinned Skullet0.0.3 source; Vite output CSS is a byte-identical existing minified build. Neither has the required leading Hallmark stamp. These are actual unsatisfied scanner requirements; no demonstrated interactive defect.

Vendor generic selectors mention controls, but the application adapter supplies noninteractive placeholder divs/spans under aria-hidden=true and inert. Application-owned controls have separate focus/active styling. No keyboard-focus regression was established by these vendor-only findings.

classifications.classification: Existing vendor fallbacks and debug selectors, compiled mirror
classifications.evidence: Neutral literals occur as --skullet-base fallbacks; loading-surfaces.css supplies the actual themed token. Pink literals belong to unused skullet-xray selectors. Vite prefixes duplicate one text-decoration occurrence. Vendor bytes remain unmodified.

Pinned check56 flags two sticky top:0 selectors without computing DOM ancestry/scroll owners. The cited modal headings and RSI/monthly table headers have separate owners and cannot be fixed by globally offsetting the second header.

classifications.classification: Unused custom-element selector in pinned vendor and compiled mirror
classifications.evidence: The flagged selector is skullet-reveal[loading]:not(:defined). The actual application uses div/span skeletonMarkup plus new Reveal(paint), not skullet-reveal tags. No application custom-element markup or xray activation was found.

The 18px top inset matches chartGeometry top=18 in apps/web/src/rsi-chart-model.ts and the explicit existing design.md requirement. Other insets match the real plot geometry; changing to a4px multiple would misalign the pending placeholder.

classifications.classification: Minor pre-existing wrapping when disclosure is opened
classifications.evidence: Remote320px finding originates inside closed details; local native probe finds checkVisibility=false while closed and true after opening. The link still uses two lines when open but all rectangles stay inside the viewport. Optional presentation polish, no demonstrated clipping or broken access.

Pinned vis() checks computed display/visibility/opacity and nonzero rectangles, but not closed-details visibility. Native1440px probe finds the content is not painted (checkVisibility=false) while raw text rectangles extend below the closed summary. Opening the first disclosure changes apparent bottom inset from -1079.1875px to +35.1875px.
